posts.name: Rabk
posts.cooked:
I've been away from the computer for a week with work - sorry for the delay. As promised, however, I'm posting some of S.I.E.V.E.'s discussions to show that the test games were not designed as pure practice runs or opportunities for a do-over, but rather part of a much larger strategic discussion regarding hero choices. 

It begins:
http://i.imgur.com/o8cjDE7.png

Some Atlantis-specific strategy talk:
http://i.imgur.com/Quz6zuR.png

A plan to shut Dawn down:
http://i.imgur.com/HfNnCqH.png

And, finally, that nasty final round, with an example of how metlarturus used a sample game to verify the viability of a particular card interaction:
http://i.imgur.com/NjCTpaU.png

 

I'm not happy with the miscommunication or how the whole thing went down, and I wanted to clear the air about the specific circumstances we were dealing with and to reiterate that nobody intentionally cheated. No hard feelings, I hope?
